detail_responses.question: In this architectural floor plan crop region (original pixel box roughly x=220-650, y=850-1000, near the bottom of the plan), there are two stacked dimension chains below the building's south wall. The upper chain reads "540, 1500, 2500, 900, 2520, 1500, 540" and the lower chain reads "4180, 1640, 4180". For the lower chain specifically: what are the approximate original-image pixel x-coordinates of its two internal tick/extension marks (the ones separating 4180|1640 and 1640|4180)? Also, looking straight up from those two tick marks into the plan interior (toward y=100-900), do they align with any visible vertical wall lines or a door/opening gap in the plan? Describe only what you observe (tick pixel positions and what vertical lines/gaps are directly above them), do not assume a specific correct room boundary.
